_comment: Everything the Windows installer build downloads is pinned or signature-checked here. See installer/README.md.

llama._comment: llama.cpp, the engine behind local models. Never downloaded at run time: the build fetches it with `python -m perplexify download-llama`, checks the SHA-256 below and stages it as <install folder>\llama. v1.0.0 is the release llama.cpp itself calls stable (its nightly-tag.txt names build b12359). The Vulkan zip holds every CPU variant (the best one is chosen at run time) plus the graphics-card back end, 13 MB more than the CPU-only zip. GitHub attests that the zip was published by ggml-org/llama.cpp's release workflow; the binaries report build 12359, commit b1b770d90, which is where the tag points. `keep` lists what stays after unpacking (everything llama-server.exe imports stays too). perplexify/localllm.py keeps an equal copy of this block for the installed app; a unit test compares them.

llama_macos._comment: The same llama.cpp build for the macOS app (.github/workflows/macos-installer.yml; installer/macos/fetch_llama.py downloads, checks and unpacks it into Perplexify.app/Contents/Resources/llama). Metal is part of the arm64 and x64 builds. The SHA-256 values are the ones GitHub shows for the release assets.
